description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Desperate Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
